desc:
⚽ Soccer Champions — Why are you reading this and not playing yet? ;)

This game is in EARLY ACCESS so please be understanding and give feedback. We can't wait for you to check it out.

🔥 Play fast-paced 4v4 stadium matches and dominate the pitch your way
🥅 Play striker, goalie or defender!
💫 Score insane goals, hit clean passes, and make clutch saves

🎮 CONTROLS (PC)
LMB – SHOOT / HEADER
RMB – DRIBBLE MOVES (Press directionally and 2x for combos)
E – SLIDE TACKLE
Q – GUARD
Shift – SPRINT
C / V – GROUND PASS / LOB PASS
Face away from goal and hold shoot while ball is above head - BICYCLE KICK

🚨 UPDATE
⚡ More modes, events, and rewards coming soon

👍 Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ for updates and codes!
💎 Roblox Premium players earn bonus coins and XP
